jurisdiction_name: GROVE CITY COUNCIL WARD 1 (GROVE CITY-CITY City)
narrative: Grove City Council Ward 1 (City of Grove City-city) has 7,047 registered voters, with 57.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 23.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 19.6%, a modest Republican lean of 3.4 percentage points.
